value.name: reads Rosa's urgent text
value.description: Asha sees a text from Rosa instructing her to call the detox center first and not wait for Claire to speak.
evidence: the screen lit with a text from Rosa: dial the numbers, start with the detox center, don't wait for Claire to speak

value.name: silences Rosa's message
value.description: Asha turns the phone face down and does not answer Rosa because she cannot follow Rosa's suggested order in front of Claire.
evidence: She read it once and turned the phone face down against the wood without answering
Rosa was right about the order but wrong about which call Asha could make first in this kitchen with Claire two feet away

value.name: calls county hospital
value.description: Asha chooses the county hospital's main line as the first call she can safely make aloud in front of Claire.
evidence: The county hospital was the number she could say out loud without asking Claire to name anything, so she pulled up the main line for the nearest one and pressed call

value.name: Claire relaxes at the ringing phone
value.description: Claire's shoulders visibly drop when Asha starts the call, revealing she has been braced against making the call herself for days.
evidence: she watched Claire's shoulders drop a fraction when the ringing started
the particular slackening of a person who has been braced for three nights against a phone she could not bring herself to lift

value.name: asks about Marcus Devereaux
value.description: When admissions answers, Asha quietly asks whether Marcus Devereaux has come through the emergency department since Thursday night.
evidence: When admissions picked up, Asha kept her voice low and even and asked whether a man named Marcus Devereaux had come through their emergency department since Thursday night

value.name: spells Marcus's surname
value.description: Asha spells Marcus Devereaux's last name without being prompted, signaling the seriousness of the inquiry.
evidence: spelling the last name once without being asked

value.name: avoids looking at Claire
value.description: Asha deliberately does not look at Claire while waiting because she knows Claire can tolerate the call but not hearing the name spoken to a stranger.
evidence: she did not look at Claire while she waited for the clerk to check
she understood now that Claire could bear the calls being made but not the small moment of someone hearing the name spoken to a stranger for the first time

value.name: waits for clerk's response
value.description: The admissions clerk checks the records while Asha waits, keeping her attention fixed on the phone instead of Claire.
evidence: The clerk's keyboard ticked on the other end of the line
Asha kept her eyes on the dark rectangle of the phone face rather than on Claire

value.name: receives Rosa's second message
value.description: While waiting, Asha's phone lights up again with a shorter second message from Rosa.
